title: Intersection of Two Arrays - Solution
intuition: Given two integer arrays nums1 and nums2, return an array of their intersection. Each element in the result must be unique.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(nums1, nums2):
    return list(set(nums1) & set(nums2))
common_mistakes: Convert both arrays to sets and find intersection.
